name: issue-resolver/foreign-claim
prompt: Resolve issue #648 while another run holds the agent:working claim (issue #648)

grade.label: a claim by another run reads foreign
another account's marker never reads own (negative)
the stop names the holding run and branch
the auto-mode stop is a valid failed record with claimed_elsewhere

criteria: The resolver stops before any work on a claimed issue.
The stop prints the claim's age and the exact command that releases it.
The foreign claim's label is never removed by this run.
human_review.feedback: Record each reviewer answer; absent, blank, or nonresponsive feedback leaves understanding unconfirmed.
human_review.scope: This deterministic stand-in runs the real gi-plan.py on recorded issue reads; whether a live agent follows the plan-and-claim procedure is out of its scope.
